s.t:
Du willst Ergebnisse, keine Diskussionen?
Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.
Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.
Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.
Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.
Was wir dir bieten
Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.
Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.
Büro in München: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.
Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.
Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.
Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.
Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.
Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

Are you motivated by building meaningful connections with senior decision makers and uncovering new business opportunities?
Do you enjoy creating innovative outreach campaigns and driving measurable impact in a fast-paced sales environment?

As part of the Intellectual Property business unit, you will focus on identifying, engaging, and qualifying new business opportunities with prospective clients. You will play a critical role in generating high-value leads and enabling Enterprise Account Managers to succeed through well-prepared meetings and insights. This role emphasizes collaboration, curiosity, and delivering a positive prospect experience.

Create target lists of key points of contact within your portfolio of prospect accounts using Salesforce, LinkedIn, and ZoomInfo
Develop creative engagement campaigns that drive curiosity using email, HubSpot, LinkedIn, and phone
Discover new business opportunities by understanding a prospect’s interests, needs, and knowledge gaps through thoughtful conversations with senior decision makers
Respond to all marketing-generated leads in a professional and timely manner to identify opportunities
Deliver a consistent volume of meetings for Enterprise Account Managers, including detailed handover notes and briefings
Provide prospects with a high-quality experience and positive impression
Use Salesforce to record all activity and client interactions, ensuring data accuracy and quality

Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience in B2B internal sales (approximately 12 months), ideally within SaaS, software, data analytics, or subscription-based solutions
Ability to confidently engage prospects by phone, establish credibility, and build rapport
Collaborative team mindset with strong interpersonal skills and resilience
Ability to work towards and achieve weekly and monthly targets
Interest in technology and innovation
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce
Familiarity with HubSpot and use of AI in sales processes
Ability to use metrics to monitor performance and understand results and drivers
Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.
Working Pattern
Working flexible hours – flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Deine Mission
syte macht Immobilienentscheidungen smarter. Unsere KI analysiert Bebauungspotenziale, Sanierungsbedarfe und Wirtschaftlichkeit in Echtzeit und gibt über 200 Projektentwickler*innen, Makler*innen und Banken die Grundlage für bessere Entscheidungen.
Um syte in noch mehr Hände zu bringen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) in Münster oder Berlin . Du bist die erste Stimme, die Entscheider*innen der Branche erreicht – du öffnest die Türen, durch die syte geht. Das bedeutet konkret:
Sniper-Outbound: Du identifizierst und kontaktierst High-Level-Entscheider*innen (Geschäftsführer*innen, Leiter*innen der Projektentwicklung, Asset Manager*innen) bei unseren Top-Target-Accounts. Kein "Spray and Pray", sondern intelligente, recherchierte Ansprache.
Pipeline Generation: Du qualifizierst Inbound-Leads und generierst durch kreatives Outbound (Cold Call, E-Mail, Social Selling, LinkedIn) neue Opportunities für unsere Account Executives.
Qualifikation: Du führst erste Qualifizierungsgespräche, verstehst die "Pain Points" der Kund*innen (lange Due Diligence, fehlende Daten) und pitchst den Mehrwert von syte.
Dein Profil
Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise hast du 6-12 Monate Erfahrung im Sales, Business Development, oder Account Management – idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Drive sind ebenfalls willkommen.
Hunter-Mentalität: Du hast keine Angst vor dem Telefonhörer. Ein "Nein" ist für dich kein Rückschlag, sondern Ansporn. Du hast Biss und willst gewinnen.
Business-Verständnis: Mit deinem Gespür für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge denkst du dich schnell in komplexe Themen ein. Du verstehst, wie Geschäftsprozesse funktionieren, bringst erstes Interesse für Tech mit und kannst echtes Interesse für die Immobilienbranche entwickeln.
Interesse an Tech & Real Estate: Du musst kein Immobilienprofi sein, aber du solltest verstehen wollen, wie unsere KI die Branche verändert.
Lernbereitschaft: Du bist coachable, willst Feedback und hast das Ziel, dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte einfach erklären und auf Augenhöhe mit C-Level-Entscheider*innen kommunizieren.
Verfügbarkeit : Du bist bereit, mehrmals wöchentlich aus unserem Office in Münster (alternativ perspektivisch aus unserem Office in Berlin) zu arbeiten.
Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort
Einstiegstermin : Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
Einsatzort: Münster oder Berlin / hybrid
Anstellungsart: Festanstellung (Vollzeit, 40 Std./Woche)

Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!
Deine Beteiligung: VSOP-Programm: In Abhängigkeit von Rolle und Verantwortungsbereich ist eine virtuelle Unternehmensbeteiligung Teil deines individuellen Vergütungspakets.
Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.
Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.
Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.
Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:
Upskilling : Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
Equipment : Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
Steueroptimierte Benefits : Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.
BusinessBike : Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction.

Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive.

With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're in a major growth phase at Bluelight, and we're seeking a highly driven Business Development Representative (BDR) with strong outbound sales experience to expand our client base. This role is focused on high-volume outbound prospecting, cold outreach, and booking qualified appointments.

The ideal candidate is confident speaking with U.S.-based decision-makers, has excellent English communication skills, and thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment.

What You'll Do Execute high-volume outbound prospecting daily (80–150+ activities/day) via cold calls, cold email, LinkedIn, and SMS Use HubSpot to manage daily outreach including call tasks, email cadences, and follow-ups Build and manage targeted prospect lists using Apollo and Clay, aligned with Bluelight's ideal customer profile Run structured multi-touch outbound sequences in Instantly to engage prospects and drive responses Write and send high-converting outbound emails and LinkedIn messages with strong personalization and clear calls-to-action Initiate outbound conversations with confidence, clearly communicating Bluelight's value proposition within the first few seconds Qualify prospects based on defined criteria (budget, authority, need, timeline) and identify real sales opportunities Handle objections effectively and position Bluelight as a solution to prospects' software and technology needs Book qualified discovery calls for Account Executives and ensure strong show rates through proper follow-up Accurately log all activities, notes, and pipeline updates in HubSpot Continuously improve messaging and outreach strategies based on results Meet or exceed KPIs including daily activity targets, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline contribution What We're Looking For Proven experience in B2B sales or inside sales roles, preferably within technology or software industries Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers confidently Familiarity with CRM software such as Salesforce or similar platforms Experience in telemarketing or outbound calling campaigns is highly desirable Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with a customer service-oriented approach Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment Nice to Have Apollo - for prospecting and lead discovery Clay - for building enriched, targeted outreach lists Instantly - for outbound email sequences and cadences Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and improve outreach performance What Success Looks Like Hitting daily activity and meeting targets Generating high-quality, qualified meetings Building a consistent and predictable pipeline Clearly communicating Bluelight's value Company Benefits Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

Generous paid-time-off policy Flexible working hours Work remotely Continuing education, training, conferences Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice.

Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth.

You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. Originally posted on Himalayas

About Huzzle At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.
About the company Our client is a results-driven B2B growth agency that specializes in bridging the gap between brand awareness and sales conversions. Based in the UK with a global reach across major hubs like New York and Dublin, the team provides a sophisticated "go-to-market as a service" model.

They integrate deep market research, creative brand positioning, and demand generation with high-performance SDR teams to build sustainable sales pipelines for scaling B2B businesses. By shifting away from traditional templated outreach, they focus on warming markets and earning prospect trust before a single call is made.
The team prides itself on an intelligence-first methodology, ensuring every campaign is backed by data and high-confidence market insights. Serving innovative founders in the SaaS, FinTech, and professional services sectors, they have a proven track record of generating millions in pipeline value.

This is a collaborative, high-growth environment suited for professionals who value transparency, original research, and the pursuit of meaningful, high-quality sales outcomes over volume-based metrics.
Job Type Full-time
Job Summary We are looking for a high-energy, German-speaking Sales Development Representative to join a premier UK-based B2B lead generation agency. In this role, you won’t just be selling a service; you will be the engine behind the growth of B2B founders globally.

We specialize in turning deep market intelligence into real-world results—meaning you will be booking high-value meetings with pre-warmed prospects who are ready to talk business. This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, global team where your performance directly impacts the company’s expansion into the DACH market.
Key Responsibilities Execute a high-volume outreach strategy with a minimum of 200 touchpoints per day.
Maintain a balanced multi-channel approach: at least 50% phone-based cold calling, supplemented by personalized email and LinkedIn outreach.
Achieve and exceed a monthly target of 12 outbound meetings booked with qualified prospects.
Identify and qualify leads effectively to ensure high conversion rates from initial contact to booked meeting.
Collaborate with the internal intelligence and creative teams to leverage pre-warmed leads and tailored content.
Manage your pipeline and activity daily using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Workspace, and Slack.
Native-level fluency in German (written and spoken).
Fluency in English (written and spoken).
Proven experience in high-volume Cold Calling and Cold Emailing.

Responsible for providing advanced product knowledge, educated recommendations and Dress Blue Experience to all customers throughout their Marine Corps Exchange shopping experience. Responsible for meeting personal and department sales goals.

Coach Sales Associates on product knowledge areas related to particular categories such as: electronics, shoes, jewelry/accessories, firearms, military clothing or other assigned areas. May be scheduled at the checkout, other departments sales areas, specialty category or customer service desk for coverage. Reports to the Sales Manager.

Takes advantage of all training opportunities to develop selling skills in product categories. Works with Team Members to develop their product knowledge within the category. Remains committed to learning about the brands and products sold within the store. Educates customers on product questions and provides suggestions when needed.

Relays customer comments and concerns to the Sales Manager. Identifies opportunities to produce add-on sales through suggestive and consultative selling. Ensures all sale, ad and promotional items are signed and placed according to brand standards. Works with the Sales Manager to achieve daily and weekly sales goals.

Assists Sales Managers and Brand Integrity Manager in the planning and execution of all corporate sales programs, promotions and other events where merchandise is involved. Builds and nurtures loyal MCX customers. Encourages and empowers all team members to identify opportunities to resolve customer problems and concerns before they happen.

Communicates any outstanding problem resolution issues with the Experience Manager. Understands and articulates all MCX value stories, programs and promotions. Recognizes the core values and mission of the Marine Corps Exchange. Identifies and reduces all risks of loss and/or theft.

Actively engages in organizational training opportunities that develop personal and professional skills related to: time management, emotional intelligence, interpersonal skills, career planning, public speaking and small group leadership.

Participates in all corporate-led training programs and works with Training Specialist to set training goals and manage training compliance, licenses and certifications and position-based learning plans. Provides World Class Customer Service with an emphasis on courtesy. Delivers a Dress Blue Experience to all customers throughout the store.

Proactively engages all customers in conversation. Addresses customers by rank when appropriate. Offers assistance and suggestive selling advice as the customer progresses throughout their shopping experience at various connecting points such as the fitting room. Assists customers and communicates positively in a friendly manner.

Understands and operates within all service policies and exercises an 'I can DO that!' mentality when a customer problem occurs. Follows up with customers to ensure their problems were resolved. Takes action to solve problems quickly. Alerts the higher-level supervisor, or proper point of contact for help when problems arise.

Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Promptly reports any observed workplace hazards, and any injury, occupational illness, and/or property damage resulting from workplace mishaps to the immediate supervisor. Adheres to established standards of actively supporting the principles of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment.

May handle customer special orders and merchandise requests. May require food handling safety training, handling and certification. May require training and handling of Western Union and other customer services offered.

May require light custodial duties, light lifting of merchandise, stocking, setting planograms, price changes, inventory counts and corrections. May have keyholder responsibility. Performs other duties as assigned. This is a white-collar position where occasional lifting up to 20 lbs. may be required.
At least one year of experience working in customer sales required. Demonstrated knowledge of selling techniques.

Ability to train operating standards and procedures for sales, signing, merchandising and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly and coach others within the team to do so with a high degree of skill and confidence. Ability to work in a high performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals.

Replenishment and merchandise management knowledge preferred. Attention to detail is required. Please include MONTH/YEAR and HOURS per week for all previous work experience listed on the resume. If there is no indication of time in position, we will credit the minimum.
Company Description

Transforming the way companies Design, Manufacture, Connect to, and Service their products, EAC Product Development Solutions (EAC) is a complete source for your product development needs.

EAC has been an industry leader for over 29 years and our experts help guide companies to achieve their strategic business goals and optimize their technology, systems, people, and processes for long-term success.

Our capabilities span the world of Additive Manufacturing/3D printing and the entirety of the manufacturing process from design ideation to product engineering to manufacturing and services in the field.
EAC CULTURE: https://www.eacpds.com/culture/
POSITION OVERVIEW - The position is a remote position. No relocation provided, must currently reside in the USA.
The AI Sales Executive is responsible for driving new business growth and expanding existing client relationships by delivering innovative AI-driven solutions to engineering and manufacturing organizations.

This role focuses on identifying practical applications of AI, including process efficiency, workflow automation, and data visibility, while guiding customers through a consultative sales process.

The AI Sales Executive will manage the full sales cycle, collaborate cross-functionally, and position the company as a trusted advisor in emerging technology solutions.
Job Description
Responsibilities, skills, and knowledge may be representative, but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with the position.
Revenue Generation & Business Development
Identify, prospect, and close new business opportunities within new and existing accounts in engineering and manufacturing markets
Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through outbound prospecting and strategic account development
Expand relationships within accounts by aligning AI solutions to broader engineering and manufacturing initiatives
Achieve or exceed assigned revenue targets and sales objectives
Consultative Selling & Solution Alignment
Lead discovery conversations to uncover customer challenges and identify practical AI applications (e.g., process efficiency, workflow automation, data visibility)
Sell a portfolio of AI services and software solutions tailored to customer needs
Translate complex AI and technical concepts into clear, business-focused value propositions
Position solutions that align with measurable customer outcomes and ROI
Sales Process Execution
Manage the full sales cycle, including: Prospecting and pipeline development

Solution positioning and demonstrations
Proposal development
Negotiation and closing
Maintain accurate forecasting and opportunity tracking within CRM systems
Market Presence & Relationship Management
Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings
Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including executive leadership and technical teams
Develop credibility as a trusted advisor within engineering and manufacturing organizations
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with technical, marketing, and leadership teams to refine offerings and go-to-market strategies
Provide actionable customer feedback to enhance solutions and sales effectiveness
Coordinate internal resources to support sales efforts and customer success
Achieving Sales Goals and KPIs
Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly activity metrics and sales quotas set by management.
Effectively overcome objections, communicate value propositions, and close deals.
Present and communicate sales offerings to customers and team members using tools like NetSuite, MS Office, and other electronic methods.
Market Knowledge and Representation
Stay informed about EAC’s product offerings and industry trends to position the company as a leader in the field.
Attend in-person or virtual sales demonstrations, trade shows, or other events to promote EAC’s solutions.
Represent EAC professionally, ensuring a strong presence in the market.

Leverage all available communication methods (calls, emails, virtual meetings) to meet activity metrics.
Collaborate across the Sales Department to share insights and refine strategies.
Perform other duties as assigned to support company objectives and market initiatives.
An equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered.

Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field preferred
5+ years of experience in enterprise or B2B technology, services, or solution sales (SaaS or mid-market preferred)
Proven success in new business development, including outbound prospecting and pipeline generation
Experience selling consultative, complex, or emerging technology solutions; AI, machine learning, analytics, or automation software experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed revenue targets
Experience working within engineering or manufacturing industries preferred
Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered

Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to uncover needs and align solutions to business outcomes
Ability to connect technical capabilities to real-world engineering and manufacturing challenges
Experience navigating complex buying environments and engaging with C-suite stakeholders

Technical & Industry Knowledge
General understanding of AI, data, and automation concepts, with the ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies

Self-motivated, results-oriented, and entrepreneurial mindset suited for a growing or evolving business
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
Experience with CRM systems (NetSuite preferred) and pipeline management
Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment with evolving offerings and processes
Comfortable working under time-sensitive deadlines and managing competing priorities
Communication & Interpersonal Skills
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Strong presentation and negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers
Ability to quickly process information and overcome objections effectively
Professional presence with the ability to build trust and credibility
Collaboration & Teamwork

Skilled in coordinating internal resources to support customer needs and sales objectives

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.
We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.
In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.
Ready to spark your growth with us?
Wen wir suchen 🦄 Als Digital Sales Consultant - Germany (w/m/d/x) bei Shopfully spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Pflege von Beziehungen zum deutschen Retail und wichtigen Werbepartnern am deutschen Markt.

Du arbeitest strategisch daran, unsere digitalen Werbelösungen zu positionieren und sicherzustellen, dass Marken und Händler ihre Drive-to-Store-Strategien maximal ausschöpfen. In deiner Rolle kombinierst du proaktiven Sales und Account Management, um neue Partnerschaften aufzubauen und bestehende auszubauen. Deine mission 🏄
Proaktive Beratung von Handels- und Retail-Partnern zur optimalen Nutzung unserer Werbelösungen.
Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Kundenstrategien mit klaren KPIs, die direkt auf die Umsatzziele der Kunden einzahlen.
Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Handelsumfeld, sowie gezieltes Upselling und Cross-Selling zur Maximierung des Umsatzwachstums mit Marken und Retail-Kunden.
Management einer Opportunity-Pipeline inklusive präziser Berichte und Forecasts für das Management.
Proaktive Neukundenakquise und strategischer Outreach im Retail-Sektor zur Gewinnung neuer Handelspartner durch Kaltakquise, Networking und gezielte Ansprache.
Betreuung, strategische Weiterentwicklung und langfristige Bindung von Bestandskunden.
Das bringst du mit 🪄
Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Account Management, idealerweise im Digital Advertising oder Ad-Tech.
Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung.
Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsaufbau, in der Verhandlung und im Stakeholder-Management, auch auf C-Level.
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten für die effiziente Beratung und Betreuung von Kund:innen sowie Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams.
Selbstständige und Eigeninitiative Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Accounts und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen.
Ausgeprägtes analytisches und datengetriebenes Mindset zur Ableitung von strategischen Insights.
Erfahrung oder großes Interesse in der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen.
Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch.
👉 In unserem Unternehmen schätzen wir Vielfalt und fördern sie aktiv – wir sind überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe uns stärker machen. Wir legen den Fokus auf Potenzial statt auf einen „perfekten“ Lebenslauf.

We work with a limited number of pre seed to Series B founders at a time, by application only. We'd rather tell someone we're not a fit before they apply than after. That selectivity is the backdrop for this role. You're not talking founders into something they'll regret.

You're helping serious operators decide whether an institutional grade process is worth committing to. Location: Work from anywhere. Funden operates across San Francisco, New York, and London, and this role can be based wherever you are. Compensation: Commission only, uncapped.

Alongside that inbound engine, you'll do outbound, sourcing founders and referral relationships that match our profile, to keep the pipeline full between cohorts. You own the conversation from first call to signed engagement.

Own your pipeline end to end, including forecasting, follow up, and CRM hygiene
Translate a nuanced offering (audit, deal materials, and a compounding signal system) into terms a founder can act on
Feed the team real signal from the market: which objections recur, which segments convert, what founders actually respond to

Comfortable, energized even, by a commission only structure, because you back your own ability to close
Credible in a room with founders and investors; you can hold a substantive conversation about fundraising, deal quality, and what actually moves capital
Genuinely willing to say no to a bad fit deal, and disciplined enough to protect the brand over a short term win
Self-directed: you build your own process, manage your own pipeline, and don't wait to be told what to do next

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

## Aufgaben ##
* Sie verantworten die interne Kommunikation unserer Dienstabteilung; dazu unterstützen Sie die Direktion und die Abteilungen bei der Gestaltung von Beiträgen und leisten redaktionelle Unterstützung, betreuen und pflegen das Intranet und andere Kommunikationsplattformen, stellen die Aktualität der Inhalte sicher, verfassen Newsbeiträge und schulen neue Mitarbeitende.

Ausserdem koordinieren Sie Aufträge und Aktivitäten mit den Kommunikationsabteilungen des Sozialdepartements und anderer Dienstabteilungen.
* Sie übernehmen die umfassende Verantwortung für die Archivierungssoftware ELO; dabei pflegen Sie das Ordnungssystem und entwickeln es nach den Vorgaben und Ansprüchen kontinuierlich weiter, schulen neue Mitarbeitende sowie Superuserinnen und Superuser in der Anwendung von ELO, vermitteln Fachwissen zu den Organisationsvorschriften und betreuen die die Kolleginnen und Kollegen in der Anwendung.

Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit der IKS-Beauftragten zusammen und integrieren die Records-Management-Prozesse in das interne Kontrollsystem.
* Sie unterstützen die Ausbildung und Betreuung unserer KV-Lernenden und begleiten sie bei Praxisaufträgen aus Ihren Aufgabenbereichen.
* Sie leisten administrative Unterstützung für die Geschäftsleitung von SDS, arbeiten aktiv in Organisationsprojekten und wirken bei der Planung und Durchführung von internen und externen Veranstaltungen mit.
## Profil ##
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung auf Tertiärstufe (Fachhochschule, Universität oder gleichwertig, z.B. Masterabschluss)
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer betriebswirtschaftlichen Stabsfunktion einer öffentlichen Verwaltung und zusätzliche Erfahrung in der Unternehmenskommunikation von Vorteil
* Ausgeprägte mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
* Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in gängigen IT-Tools (insbesondere SharePoint, Microsoft Office) sowie hohe Affinität zu digitalen Medien und modernen Kommunikationsformen
* Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und behalten auch bei komplexeren Aufgabenstellungen den Überblick
* Freude an der Tätigkeit in einer Stabsfunktion, arbeiten gerne vernetzt und bringen ein ausgeprägtes Dienstleistungsverständnis mit
* Tragen gerne Mitverantwortung in der Ausbildung und verfügen idealerweise über Kenntnisse in der Betreuung und Förderung von Lernenden oder sind bereit, sich diese Kenntnisse anzueignen
## Wir bieten ##
Eine abwechslungsreiche, herausfordernde und vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem spannenden Umfeld. Neben einem attraktiven Arbeitsplatz im Herzen der Stadt Zürich sowie einem engagierten und motivierten Team, profitieren Sie von fortschrittlichen und guten Anstellungsbedingungen sowie einem internen Weiterbildungsangebot.
